dialogue.content: こんにちは。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。定刻より始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming today. We will be starting at the scheduled time.

dialogue.content: （了解しました。本日はよろしくお願いいたします^_^）
dialogue.English: (Understood. I'm looking forward to our session today. ^_^)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談者です。初めに年齢、性別、相談内容を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I am the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 24才　女
dialogue.English: 24, female.

dialogue.content: 別れた彼氏の事です
dialogue.English: It's about my ex-boyfriend.

dialogue.content: ご相談ありがとうございます。彼氏さんのことですね。どのうような相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing. So, it's about your ex-boyfriend. What would you like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 相談というか、もう辛くて。二股をかけられていました
dialogue.English: It's not so much that I need advice... I'm just in so much pain. He was two-timing me.

dialogue.content: 私が二股側です。彼女が妊婦でした
dialogue.English: I was the other woman. His girlfriend was pregnant.

dialogue.content: それはとても辛いですよね。許せない気持ちになりますよね。しかも妊婦さんということは彼氏さんとのお子さんですか？
dialogue.English: That must be incredibly painful. It's natural to feel that you can't forgive him. And since she's pregnant, is the child his?

dialogue.content: 辛いです。彼氏との子供で、私が付き合うよりも早く妊娠してたんです。
dialogue.English: It's painful. It is his child, and she got pregnant before we even started dating.

dialogue.content: 付き合ってすぐに、彼氏が経営してる会社に連れて行ってくれて、部活と一緒に食事したり、結婚したら多摩川の方に家を立てようとか言われてて。信頼してました
dialogue.English: Right after we started dating, he took me to the company he runs, we had dinner with his employees, and he would say things like, "Let's build a house near the Tama River when we get married." I trusted him.

dialogue.content: そこまで信頼されていて、それは傷付きますよね。それはひどいですね。
dialogue.English: To have trusted him that much, that must be so hurtful. That's terrible.

dialogue.content: 本当にひどいです！
dialogue.English: It's truly terrible!

dialogue.content: 完全に騙していたということですもんね。怒りもそうとう込みあげてきたのではないですか？
dialogue.English: It means he was completely deceiving you. I imagine a lot of anger must be welling up, too?

dialogue.content: 怒りもあるし、何よりも悲しくて。もう死のうと思ったけど
dialogue.English: There's anger, but more than anything, I'm sad. I even thought about ending my life, but...

dialogue.content: なるほど。悲しくなるほど、信頼されていたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Your sadness shows just how much you trusted him.

dialogue.content: 死のうと思われるぐらい真剣にその彼氏を愛されていたのですね。
dialogue.English: You must have loved him so much that you even considered ending your life.

dialogue.content: ベランダから飛び降りても、誰も止めてくれる人がいない。こんなひどい彼氏に殺されるなんて嫌だ！　と思って、それだけは留まっています
dialogue.English: Even if I jumped from my balcony, there would be no one to stop me. But I thought, "I refuse to let such a terrible man be the cause of my death!" So that's the only thing that's stopping me.

dialogue.content: もう裏切りが酷くて、愛とか分からなくなりました
dialogue.English: The betrayal was so severe that I don’t even know what love is anymore.

dialogue.content: 留まられたのは正解だと思います。おっしゃる通りそのような人が原因で命を投げ出す必要はないと思います。
dialogue.English: I think you made the right decision to stop yourself. Just as you said, there's no need to throw your life away for someone like that.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。人が信じられなくなりますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It would make anyone unable to trust people.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: その彼氏と別れたのは最近なのですか？
dialogue.English: Did you break up with him recently?

dialogue.content: 人もだし、自分も分からなくなりました。
dialogue.English: Not just other people; I don't even understand myself anymore.

dialogue.content: 2週間くらい前です。
dialogue.English: About two weeks ago.

dialogue.content: そのぐらい大事に思っていらっしゃったのですね。
dialogue.English: You must have cared for him that deeply.

dialogue.content: それももう分かりません。私っていう存在が、何の価値もない感じ。
dialogue.English: I don't even know anymore. I feel like my very existence has no value.

dialogue.content: 彼氏が出来た事を男友達に話したら、自分も好きだったって告白されて。
dialogue.English: When I told a male friend that I had a boyfriend, he confessed that he had feelings for me, too.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: なかなか諦めてくれなくて、彼氏が家に来てる時に友達が来て、どういう事だって怒られたんです。ビンタもされました。
dialogue.English: He wouldn’t give up, and one time he came over while my boyfriend was at my place. He got angry, demanding what was going on, and even slapped me.

dialogue.content: なのに彼氏の方がよっぽどひどい事してて。
dialogue.English: And yet, what my boyfriend was doing was so much worse.

dialogue.content: 何なんでしょう
dialogue.English: I just don't understand it.

dialogue.content: 人の心がない人だったとか思えない
dialogue.English: I can’t just write him off as someone without a heart.

dialogue.content: ◯だったとしか
dialogue.English: All I can think is that he was ○.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。かなり辛い経験をいっぱいしてこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You have gone through so many painful experiences.

dialogue.content: それは他人が信じられなくなってもしかたないですよね。
dialogue.English: It's no wonder you find it difficult to trust others.

dialogue.content: その男友達さんとはその後どのような関係になられたのですか？
dialogue.English: What has your relationship with that male friend been like since then?

dialogue.content: 告白してきた友達はもう音信不通です。付き合う事は出来なかったけど、あんな別れ方をしなくて済んだはずだったし。
dialogue.English: I'm no longer in contact with the friend who confessed to me. We couldn't have dated, but we shouldn't have had to part ways like that.

dialogue.content: 友達にも悪い事したなって思うと、それも辛い。仲が良かったんです。
dialogue.English: It also hurts to think that I did something wrong to my friend. We were close.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それでも友達に悪いことをしたなと思われる相談者さんは本当に優しい方なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. The fact that you still feel you did something wrong to your friend shows that you are a very kind person.

dialogue.content: 優しくはないです。
dialogue.English: I'm not kind.

dialogue.content: 本当に友達に辛い思いさせたんだし。
dialogue.English: I really did hurt my friend.

dialogue.content: 思ってくれる友達を切って選んだ人が、あんな人だなんて、私って最低
dialogue.English: The person I chose over a friend who cared for me turned out to be like that... I'm the worst.

dialogue.content: ずっと辛くて。頭ぐちゃぐちゃです
dialogue.English: It's been so painful. My head is a mess.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must be painful.

dialogue.content: 頭の中をひっくり返して洗いたいくらいです
dialogue.English: I feel like I want to turn my mind inside out and wash it clean.

dialogue.content: それほどご自身を責めておられるのですね。
dialogue.English: That shows how much you’re blaming yourself.

dialogue.content: 何であんなに騙さんるでしょう。部下も一緒になって騙してたんです
dialogue.English: Why would he deceive me like that? His subordinates were in on it, too.

dialogue.content: 部下というのは彼氏さんの会社の方ですかね？
dialogue.English: By subordinates, do you mean people from his company?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんは会社の方ともお会いになったのですね。どのような会話をしたのですか？
dialogue.English: So you also met the people at his company. What kind of conversations did you have?

dialogue.content: 一緒食事したり、私の事を歓迎してくれてました
dialogue.English: We had meals together, and they were very welcoming to me.

dialogue.content: 部下の人は彼氏さんが二股していることは知っていたのですか？
dialogue.English: Did his subordinates know that he was two-timing you?

dialogue.content: お似合いだとか、社長に彼女できて良かったとか言って、気もつかってくれてました。
dialogue.English: They said we looked good together, that they were glad the boss had a girlfriend, and they were very considerate.

dialogue.content: それは聞いてないですが、妊娠8ヶ月の彼女がいて、私を会社に連れて行くくらいだから、妊婦の方にも同じことをしてたと思うんです
dialogue.English: I haven't asked, but considering he had a girlfriend who was eight months pregnant and still brought me to his company, I assume he was doing the same thing to her as well.

dialogue.content: 彼女は婚約指輪もらってたし
dialogue.English: And she had an engagement ring, too.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それは疑いたくなりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That would certainly make you suspicious.

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんとはどのようにして別れたのですか？
dialogue.English: How did you end up breaking up with him?

dialogue.content: 彼女が私の存在をスマホの履歴から気づいて、私に電話してきたんです。それで3人で会う事になって。、
dialogue.English: His girlfriend found out about me from his phone history and called me. So the three of us ended up meeting.

dialogue.content: はい。どのような会話をされたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What was said during that meeting?

dialogue.content: 彼氏はほぼ無言。彼女が品定めみたいに私を見て、あんたの好きなタイプね、みたいな事言って、彼氏を散々罵りました
dialogue.English: My boyfriend was mostly silent. His girlfriend looked me up and down as if she were sizing me up, said something like, "So, you're his type," and then just tore into him.

dialogue.content: 私はもう、言葉もないって感じでした。
dialogue.English: I was just speechless.

dialogue.content: 彼女は、ベランダから飛び降りようとしたら彼が止めたから死ななかったけど、こんな男いらない、あなたにあげるって。
dialogue.English: She said that she tried to jump from the balcony, but he stopped her, so she didn't die. Then she said she doesn't want a man like him and that I could have him.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それで相談者さんはなんと？
dialogue.English: I see. And what did you say?

dialogue.content: あー、この人は止めてくれる人がいるから死のうとできたんだな、って思って。私が自分で踏みとどまったのとはまるで違う立場でした、
dialogue.English: I thought, 'Oh, she was able to attempt to die because she had someone who would stop her.' It was a completely different situation from mine, where I had to stop myself.

dialogue.content: 守ってくれる人がいると思われたということですね。
dialogue.English: So you felt she had someone to protect her.

dialogue.content: 私もいらないと言いました。私が好きだったのは、私を好きな彼なので、二股する男はいりません
dialogue.English: I said I didn't want him either. The person I loved was the version of him that loved me; I don't need a man who cheats.

dialogue.content: さう思ったら、よけいに惨めでした。
dialogue.English: Thinking that made me feel even more miserable.

dialogue.content: 彼女と2人で彼氏を責めてても、事実は変わらないし虚しくなって、帰りました。
dialogue.English: Even with the two of us blaming him, the facts wouldn't change. It just felt empty, so I left.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。確かに虚しいだけですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It certainly does just feel empty, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 辛い過去をお話しくださり、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing such a painful experience with me.

dialogue.content: 虚しいし馬鹿みたいでした。
dialogue.English: It was empty, and I felt like a fool.

dialogue.content: これからどうしたらいいのかなこんな私を好きになってくれる人なんていないのかな
dialogue.English: I don’t know what I should do from here. I wonder if anyone could ever love someone like me.

dialogue.content: 泣けてきます
dialogue.English: It's making me cry.

dialogue.content: 悲しい気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel sad.

dialogue.content: 悲しいです。それに怖いです。
dialogue.English: I'm sad. And I'm scared.

dialogue.content: 怖いというのは何に対してでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What is it that you’re scared of?

dialogue.content: これからどう生きていったらいいのか
dialogue.English: How I'm supposed to live my life from now on.

dialogue.content: 辛いことばかりでこの先がどうなるのか怖いということなのですね。
dialogue.English: So after all these painful experiences, you're scared of what the future holds.

dialogue.content: はい。私を好きになってくれる人なんていない気がするし、
dialogue.English: Yes. I feel like no one will ever love me, and...

dialogue.content: 立ち直れるのか。
dialogue.English: ...whether I can ever recover.

dialogue.content: 辛いことばかりで立ち直れるかわからなくなりますよね。
dialogue.English: After so many painful things, it's normal to wonder if you'll be able to recover.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 好きになってくれる人がいない気がするのはなんでですか？
dialogue.English: What makes you feel that no one will ever love you?

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: Well...

dialogue.content: 浮気相手にされる程度の人間なのかなって。
dialogue.English: I guess I feel like I'm only good enough to be the other woman.

dialogue.content: そう思われるのですね。今までも同じような経験がおありですか？
dialogue.English: That's how you see yourself. Have you had similar experiences in the past?

dialogue.content: 今まで…
dialogue.English: In the past...

dialogue.content: はい、、、もしいい辛いようであれば大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes... but if it's too difficult to talk about, that's okay.

dialogue.content: そうですね…。二股はなかったけど、何となく付き合う感じの人もいました。自然消滅もあったかな。
dialogue.English: Well... I hadn't been two-timed before, but there were guys I kind of just fell into dating. I think some relationships just fizzled out, too.

dialogue.content: なるほど。では浮気されたのは今回が初めてということですかね？
dialogue.English: I see. So this is the first time you’ve been cheated on?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 浮気されたんじゃなくて、二股側だったのが大きいです
dialogue.English: It's not that I was cheated on; it's that I was the 'other woman.' That's the most important part.

dialogue.content: 最初から本気じゃないじゃないですか
dialogue.English: It means he wasn't serious from the very beginning, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: なるほど。騙されていたというところが大きいということですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So the fact that you were deceived is what feels most significant to you.

dialogue.content: そうですね。妊婦が出てきたら衝撃的すぎますよ
dialogue.English: Yes. Having a pregnant woman show up is just too shocking.

dialogue.content: それは衝撃的すぎます。何も言えなくなりますよね。
dialogue.English: That is overwhelmingly shocking. It would leave you speechless.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: すみません。お時間になってしまいました。ここまでお話しをしてみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, but our time is up. How do you feel after having talked things through today?

dialogue.content: 色々愚痴が言えました。
dialogue.English: I was able to vent about a lot of things.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいか分からないけど…
dialogue.English: I still don't know what to do, though...

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ここまでお話聞いていて相談者さんに落ち度がないと思いました。彼氏のことはもちろん。男友達のことも彼氏の話をするまでは二股をするような人だと相談者さんは知らなかったわけですし、ご自身を責める必要ないと思いました。
dialogue.English: Thank you. From listening to your story, I don't think you are at fault at all. Certainly not regarding your boyfriend. And regarding your male friend, at the time you told him about your new boyfriend, you had no idea that boyfriend was a two-timer, so I don't think you need to blame yourself.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。私は悪くない…
dialogue.English: Thank you. So I'm not the one to blame...

dialogue.content: 本当にそう思います。それととても優しくていい人なのだと思いました。普通ならもっと彼氏さんに怒ってもいいと思いますし、男友達に関しても家に入ってきて怒ってくるのが常識としてどうかと思いました。
dialogue.English: I truly believe so. I also felt that you are a very kind and good person. It would be normal to be much angrier at your boyfriend, and as for your male friend, I question the propriety of someone who would come into your home and get angry like that.

dialogue.content: それなのに相談者さんは友達に悪いことをしたとご自身をせめておられるところに、優しさを感じました。
dialogue.English: Despite that, you blame yourself, feeling you did something wrong to your friend, and I felt a kindness in that.

dialogue.content: 男友達の方には怒るって発想がなかったです。想ってくれたのに悪いことしたな、タイミングが悪かったな、って申し訳ないばかりでした。
dialogue.English: The thought of being angry at my male friend never even occurred to me. I just felt sorry, thinking that I'd done something wrong to him even though he cared for me, and that the timing was just bad.

dialogue.content: そこが相談者さんの優しさだなって思いました。すみません。完全に私の感想を述べてしまいました。
dialogue.English: That’s exactly where I see your kindness. I’m sorry—I ended up giving you my personal impressions.

dialogue.content: 今回はショックが強すぎてぐちゃぐちゃになってますが、もしかしたら、元々自分を責める性格なのかも知れません。
dialogue.English: This time the shock was so great that I'm a mess, but maybe I have a personality that tends to blame myself to begin with.

dialogue.content: いえ、感想を言ってもらって、気づくこともありました。
dialogue.English: No, hearing your impressions helped me realize some things.

dialogue.content: なるほど。そうなのですね。気づきがあったよかったです。
dialogue.English: I see. That's good that you had that realization.

dialogue.content: 今はしんど過ぎるけど、自分を、責めやすい性格で余計に辛くなってるのかも知れないなって。
dialogue.English: It's too hard right now, but I'm thinking that maybe I'm making it even harder on myself because of my tendency to blame myself.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。ご自身を労ってみるのもいいかもですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It might be a good idea to try being kind to yourself.

dialogue.content: 自分を労うのもしたことないかも知れません。
dialogue.English: I don't think I've ever even tried being kind to myself.

dialogue.content: どうやるのか分かりませんが、考えてみたいと思います
dialogue.English: I don't know how to do it, but I'd like to think about it.

dialogue.content: ぜひ、してみてください。もう十分自分を責めたし悲しんだからお疲れ様みたいな気持ちで遊びだったり楽しいことに時間を使うと労えるかと。
dialogue.English: Please do. You've blamed yourself and been sad enough. Try spending time on fun activities with the feeling of, "You've been through enough, you deserve a break." That might be a way to be kind to yourself.

dialogue.content: ご褒美な感じでしょうか。まだまだ考えてしまうでしょうが、ゆったりしたいですね。温泉とかいいかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Like a reward? I'll probably still overthink things, but I would like to relax. A hot spring might be nice.

dialogue.content: いいと思います。ご自身にご褒美をあげてみてください。お時間になってしまいました。また苦しくなったときはいつでもお越しください。
dialogue.English: I think that's a wonderful idea. Please give yourself a reward. Our time is up now. Please feel free to come back anytime you're feeling distressed.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。もう少し自分でも揉んでみます。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. I'll try to work through this a bit more on my own.

dialogue.content: はい。またそのあとの状況もお話し聞かせてください。それではこれで相談を終了させていただきます。本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Of course. Please come back and tell me how things are going afterward. This concludes our session for today. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （時間過ぎてしまって、申し訳ありません。お疲れ様でした。）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry we went over time. Thank you for your hard work.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそお付き合いいただいてありがとうございました。また機会がありましたらよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.English: (Not at all, thank you for your time as well. I hope we can do this again if there's another opportunity.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそ是非よろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Likewise, I would be very happy to work with you again.)
